defects_neutralized.description: Bare '&' in SVG text nodes aborts Chromium/WebKit XML parser rendering.
defects_neutralized.rule: All '&' in SVGs must strictly be '&' or replaced with '+'/'and'.

defects_neutralized.description: Explicit 'slug:' in markdown frontmatter conflicting with content collection filenames.
defects_neutralized.rule: Avoid redundant 'slug:' key in blog frontmatter under Astro 5 glob-loader.

defects_neutralized.description: Browser caches failed 404 or corrupted XML images indefinitely.
defects_neutralized.rule: Employ <picture> tag with dual SVG/PNG fallback and query string cache-busting.

defects_neutralized.description: Outbound /go/* redirects pointing to nonexistent review slugs.
defects_neutralized.rule: Enforce 100% parity between _redirects routes and reviewed software.
